abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic cancer is one of the most fatal malignancies with the lowest 5-year survival worldwide. Radioresistance remains the major challenge for pancreatic cancer treatment. The aim of this study is to unravel the mechanism underlying PAFAH1B1-regulated radiosensitivity in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).
METHODS: Immunohistochemistry (IHC), western blot or qRT-PCR were employed to detect the expression of PAFAH1B1, PUM2 and other molecules. Two radiation-resistant (RR) PDAC cell lines and a xenograft mouse model were established. CCK-8, colony formation assays and flow cytometry analysis were used to assess cell proliferation and apoptosis in PDAC cells, respectively. Ferroptosis was evaluated using commercial kits and BODIPY 581/591 C11 staining. The association between PUM2 and PAFAH1B1 3'UTR, as well as between miR-421/miR-301a-3p and PAFAH1B1 3'UTR, were detected by luciferase and RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) assays.
RESULTS: PAFAH1B1 was downregulated in PDAC, and it was associated with unfavorable prognosis and radiotherapy response of PDAC patients. PAFAH1B1 overexpression enhanced the radiosensitivity to 125I particle in BxPC-3-RR, PANC-1-RR cells and PANC-1-RR xenograft tumors. Overexpression of PAFAH1B1 potentiated radiation-impaired cell viability and proliferation via triggering ferroptosis in PDAC cells. Mechanistically, PUM2 increased PAFAH1B1 expression via competitively binding to PAFAH1B1 3'UTR with miR-421 and miR-301a-3p. Moreover, PUM2 promoted radiation-induced ferroptosis in a PAFAH1B1-dependent manner.
CONCLUSION: PUM2/PAFAH1B1 axis decreased the radioresistance to 125I radioactive particles in PDAC via triggering ferroptosis.
key_points_ko: 췌관선암에서 PAFAH1B1 단백질의 발현 감소는 환자의 불량한 예후 및 방사선 치료 반응 저하와 관련이 있었습니다.
방사선 저항성 암세포 및 동물 모델에서 PAFAH1B1 과발현 시 페롭토시스가 유도되어 125I 방사선 감수성이 향상되었습니다.
PUM2는 miR-421 및 miR-301a-3p와의 경쟁적 결합을 통해 PAFAH1B1을 안정화시켜 방사선 저항성을 줄였습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 췌관선암(PDAC)의 주요 치료 난제인 방사선 저항성을 극복하기 위해 PAFAH1B1 단백질의 조절 기전을 규명한 전임상 기초 연구입니다. 연구진은 방사선 저항성 췌장암 세포주와 마우스 이종이식 모델을 제작하여 세포 증식, 사멸 및 페롭토시스(ferroptosis, 철 의존성 세포사멸) 변화를 분석했습니다. 연구 결과, 췌관선암 조직에서 PAFAH1B1 발현이 낮을수록 환자의 예후 및 방사선 치료 반응이 불량했습니다. PUM2 단백질이 마이크로RNA(miR-421, miR-301a-3p)와의 경쟁적 결합을 통해 PAFAH1B1 발현을 안정화시키고, 페롭토시스를 유발하여 125I 방사선 입자에 대한 감수성을 높였습니다.
title: PAFAH1B1 stabilization, through PUM2-mediated competitive binding with miRNAs on its' 3'-UTR, takes active actions on ferroptosis to overcome the radioresistance to 125I radioactive particles of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
title_ko: PUM2 매개 조절을 통한 PAFAH1B1 안정화가 페롭토시스를 유도하여 췌관선암의 125I 방사선 입자 저항성을 극복함
